Subject: Need help with a cheque bounce case

Hello, my name is Swati Naidu. I am a 29-year-old journalist living in Jaipur. Vindhya Enterprises gave me a cheque for INR 21,60,000/- to repay a loan, but the cheque was returned unpaid for insufficient funds. My case number is CC/2899/2019 in the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Jaipur. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 76734 41637 or email swati.naidu47@example.in.
